//: Copy this file to sdk-test.config.json (git-ignored) and fill in what you want
checked by `npm run check`. Every section is optional; leave a value at 0 or ""
to skip it. Nothing is ever signed: do NOT put a key or mnemonic here — a config
registry: a registry app id. With owner, also checks that address's entitlement.
passport: your passport app id. Checks its state and simulates its upgrade.
swaps: routes to build and strict-simulate from your passport. Give each one
either `session` — a saved router session (a JSON array of base64 msgpack
transactions), relative to this file — or a `quote` object, which is sent to
quote.url verbatim, so your router's own parameter names apply. The passport's
application address is added as the sender. `npm run check -- --save` writes
quote.url: the router API base, which serves POST /quote and POST /execute.
maintainer.registries: what `npm run live-check` runs against when given no ids
({ id, expect: line|major, label?, note? }). Defaults to the production registry.
